visual.name: accentKpiCard
visual.description: KPI card with an accent bar, formatted value, optional subtitle and caption, and a direction-aware delta badge. Includes a header mode that renders a crisp text header.

en-US.subtitle: Subtitle
en-US.Landing_Body: Add a measure to the Value field to get started. Bind Delta for a direction aware badge, Subtitle for text beside the value, and Cross-filter field to let clicks filter the page.

dataRoles.name: filterField
dataRoles.description: Optional. Bind the field this card represents (e.g. a region or KPI name); clicking the card then cross-filters the page by it.
